023import java.util.*;

035/**
036 * A specialized invoker for methods that are called during a servlet request.
037 *
038 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
039 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/RestContext">RestContext</a>
040 * </ul>
041 */
042public class RestOpInvoker extends MethodInvoker {
043
044   private final RestOpArg[] opArgs;
045   private final Supplier<Object> resourceSupplier;
046
047   /**
048    * Constructor.
049    *
050    * @param m The method being wrapped.
051    * @param opArgs The parameter resolvers.
052    * @param stats The instrumentor.
053    */
054   public RestOpInvoker(java.lang.reflect.Method m, RestOpArg[] opArgs, MethodExecStats stats) {
055      this(m, opArgs, stats, null);
056   }
057
058   /**
059    * Constructor.
060    *
061    * @param m The method being wrapped.
062    * @param opArgs The parameter resolvers.
063    * @param stats The instrumentor.
064    * @param resourceSupplier Optional resource supplier.  When <jk>null</jk>, falls back to {@link RestSession#getResource()}.
065    */
066   public RestOpInvoker(java.lang.reflect.Method m, RestOpArg[] opArgs, MethodExecStats stats, Supplier<Object> resourceSupplier) {
067      super(m, stats);
068      this.opArgs = opArgs;
069      this.resourceSupplier = resourceSupplier;
070   }
071
072   /**
073    * Invokes this method from the specified {@link RestOpSession}.
074    *
075    * @param opSession The REST call. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
076    * @throws Exception If an error occurred during either parameter resolution or method invocation.
077    */
078   public void invoke(RestOpSession opSession) throws Exception {
079      invoke(opSession, false);
080   }
081
082   /**
083    * Invokes this method as the main {@code @RestOp} handler from the specified {@link RestOpSession},
084    * firing per-request observability hooks ({@link MetricsRecorder} and {@link TracerHook}) around the
085    * underlying invocation.
086    *
087    * <p>
088    * Called by {@link RestOpSession#run()} for the {@code @RestOp}-annotated handler method. Pre / post
089    * call methods (those invoked via {@link RestContext#preCall(RestOpSession)} /
090    * {@link RestContext#postCall(RestOpSession)}) continue to use {@link #invoke(RestOpSession)} so the
091    * observability boundary stays anchored on the user-facing handler.
092    *
093    * <h5 class='section'>Virtual-thread dispatch</h5>
094    * <p>
095    * When the operation opts into virtual threads via {@code @Rest(virtualThreads=true)} or
096    * {@code @RestOp(virtualThreads=true)} and the runtime is Java 21+, the entire body of this method
097    * (parameter resolution, observability scope opening, handler invocation, observability close) is
098    * submitted to the resource's virtual-thread executor and the request thread blocks on completion.
099    * That keeps observability scoping correct (open and close run on the same thread) while letting
100    * blocking I/O inside the handler park a virtual thread instead of the carrier.
101    *
102    * <h5 class='section'>{@link CompletableFuture} returns</h5>
103    * <p>
104    * When the handler returns a {@link CompletionStage}, the observability close is deferred to the
105    * future's {@code whenComplete} callback so metrics and traces capture the actual completion time
106    * and outcome — not the synchronous "future returned" moment.
107    *
108    * @param opSession The REST call. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
109    * @throws Exception If an error occurred during either parameter resolution or method invocation.
110    */
111   @SuppressWarnings({
112      "java:S3776", // Cognitive complexity acceptable for REST operation invocation dispatch (virtual-thread + observability paths)
113      "java:S1181"  // Throwable (incl. Error) is intentionally captured to propagate it across the virtual-thread boundary; the caller rethrows Errors as-is.
114   })
115   public void invokeOp(RestOpSession opSession) throws Exception {
116      var vtExec = opSession.getContext().isVirtualThreadsEnabled()
117         ? opSession.getRestContext().getVirtualThreadExecutor()
118         : null;
119
120      if (vtExec == null) {
121         invoke(opSession, true);
122         return;
123      }
124
125      var f = new CompletableFuture<Void>();
126      vtExec.execute(() -> {
127         try {
128            invoke(opSession, true);
129            f.complete(null);
130         } catch (Throwable t) {
131            f.completeExceptionally(t);
132         }
133      });
134
135      try {
136         f.get();
137      } catch (ExecutionException ee) {
138         Throwable cause = ee.getCause() == null ? ee : ee.getCause();
139         if (cause instanceof Exception cause2)
140            throw cause2;
141         if (cause instanceof Error cause2)
142            throw cause2;
143         throw new InternalServerError(cause);
144      } catch (InterruptedException ie) {
145         Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
146         throw new InternalServerError(ie);
147      }
148   }
149
150   @SuppressWarnings({
151      "java:S3776", // Cognitive complexity acceptable for the dispatch hot path.
152      "resource"    // BeanStore is not owned here; its lifecycle is managed by RestContext.
153   })
154   private void invoke(RestOpSession opSession, boolean observable) throws Exception {
155      var args = new Object[opArgs.length];
156      for (var i = 0; i < opArgs.length; i++) {
157         ParameterInfo pi = inner().getParameter(i);
158         try {
159            args[i] = opArgs[i].resolve(opSession);
160         } catch (BasicHttpException e) {
161            throw e;
162         } catch (Exception e) {
163            throw new BadRequest(e, "Could not resolve parameter %s of type '%s' on method '%s'.", i, pi.getParameterType(), getFullName());
164         }
165      }
166
167      RestRequest req = opSession.getRequest();
168      RestResponse res = opSession.getResponse();
169
170      MetricsRecorder recorder = NoOpMetricsRecorder.INSTANCE;
171      Scope tracerScope = NoOpTracerHook.NoOpScope.INSTANCE;
172      long startNanos = 0L;
173      Throwable observed = null;
174      boolean observabilityDeferred = false;
175      boolean scopeStashed = false;
176      var opContext = opSession.getContext();
177      // observable=true means this is the @RestOp handler (not a pre/post call), AND observability is not
178      // explicitly disabled for this operation via @Rest(observability="false") or @RestOp(observability="false").
179      boolean effectivelyObservable = observable && opContext.isObservabilityEnabled();
180      if (effectivelyObservable) {
181         var bs = opSession.getRestContext().getBeanStore();
182         recorder = bs.getBean(MetricsRecorder.class).orElse(NoOpMetricsRecorder.INSTANCE);
183         var tracer = bs.getBean(TracerHook.class).orElse(NoOpTracerHook.INSTANCE);
184         if (tracer == NoOpTracerHook.INSTANCE) {
185            // No-tracer fast path: resolve neither a TraceContextExtractor nor a carrier/operation, and
186            // touch no request-scoped tracing attribute — matches the pre-existing zero-allocation contract.
187            tracerScope = tracer.startSpan(req);
188         } else {
189            // Active tracer: an optional TraceContextExtractor gets a look at the fully-resolved operation
190            // arguments (parsed request body / params included) before span creation, so it can recognize a
191            // non-HTTP carrier (e.g. an MCP request's params._meta) that HTTP headers alone wouldn't expose.
192            Optional<TraceContextExtractor> extractor = bs.getBean(TraceContextExtractor.class);
193            TraceContextCarrier carrier = null;
194            TraceOperation operation = TraceOperation.DEFAULT;
195            if (extractor.isPresent()) {
196               carrier = extractor.get().extract(req, args).orElse(null);
197               operation = extractor.get().operation(req, args);
198            }
199            tracerScope = tracer.startSpan(req, carrier, operation);
200            // Stash the active Scope as a request-scoped neutral tracing observation so a dated MCP adapter
201            // running inside this handler invocation (and already holding this same RestRequest through its
202            // own request-scoped BeanStore entry) can call Scope#recordRpcError(int, String) before returning
203            // a JSON-RPC error response. Cleared below once this invocation's synchronous/deferred
204            // observability lifecycle closes the scope.
205            req.setAttribute(TraceContextResponseProcessor.ATTR_SCOPE, tracerScope);
206            scopeStashed = true;
207         }
208         startNanos = System.nanoTime();
209      }
210
211      try {
212         RestSession session = opSession.getRestSession();
213
214         var target = resourceSupplier == null ? session.getResource() : resourceSupplier.get();
215         Object output = super.invoke(target, args);
216
217         // Handle manual call to req.setDebug().
218         Boolean debug = req.getAttribute("Debug").as(Boolean.class).orElse(null);
219         if (debug == Boolean.TRUE) {
220            session.debug(true);
221         } else if (debug == Boolean.FALSE) {
222            session.debug(false);
223         }
224
225         if (! inner().hasReturnType(Void.TYPE) && (nn(output) || ! res.getOutputStreamCalled()))
226            res.setContent(output);
227
228         if (effectivelyObservable && output instanceof CompletionStage<?> output2) {
229            observabilityDeferred = true;
230            deferObservability(output2, recorder, tracerScope, startNanos, opSession, opContext.getMetricName(), opContext.getMetricTags(), scopeStashed);
231         }
232
233      } catch (IllegalAccessException | IllegalArgumentException e) {
234         observed = e;
235         throw new InternalServerError(e, "Error occurred invoking method '%s'.", inner().getNameFull());
236      } catch (InvocationTargetException e) {
237         Throwable e2 = e.getTargetException();
238         observed = e2;
239         res.setStatus(500);  // May be overridden later.
240         res.setContent(opSession.getRestContext().convertThrowable(e2));
241      } finally {
242         if (effectivelyObservable && ! observabilityDeferred) {
243            int status;
244            if (observed != null)
245               status = deriveStatus(observed);
246            else {
247               status = res.getStatus();
248               if (status == 0)
249                  status = 200;
250            }
251            try {
252               tracerScope.setStatusCode(status);
253               if (nn(observed))
254                  tracerScope.setError(observed);
255            } finally {
256               try {
257                  tracerScope.close();
258               } finally {
259                  if (scopeStashed)
260                     req.setAttribute(TraceContextResponseProcessor.ATTR_SCOPE, null);
261                  var elapsed = Duration.ofNanos(System.nanoTime() - startNanos);
262                  var pathTemplate = resolveUriTemplate(opSession);
263                  recorder.record(getFullName(), req.getMethod(), pathTemplate, status, elapsed, observed, opContext.getMetricName(), opContext.getMetricTags());
264               }
265            }
266         }
267      }
268   }
269
270   @SuppressWarnings("java:S107") // Parameter list is fixed by the framework invocation contract; grouping into a holder would not improve clarity.
271   private void deferObservability(CompletionStage<?> stage, MetricsRecorder recorder, Scope tracerScope,
272         long startNanos, RestOpSession opSession, String metricName, String metricTags, boolean scopeStashed) {
273      var fullName = getFullName();
274      var req = opSession.getRequest();
275      var httpMethod = req.getMethod();
276      var pathTemplate = resolveUriTemplate(opSession);
277      stage.whenComplete((value, error) -> {
278         Throwable err = unwrapCompletionError(error);
279         int status = deriveStatus(err);
280         try {
281            tracerScope.setStatusCode(status);
282            if (err != null)
283               tracerScope.setError(err);
284         } finally {
285            try {
286            tracerScope.close();
287         } finally {
288            if (scopeStashed)
289               req.setAttribute(TraceContextResponseProcessor.ATTR_SCOPE, null);
290            var elapsed = Duration.ofNanos(System.nanoTime() - startNanos);
291            recorder.record(fullName, httpMethod, pathTemplate, status, elapsed, err, metricName, metricTags);
292         }
293         }
294      });
295   }
296
297   private static Throwable unwrapCompletionError(Throwable t) {
298      if (t instanceof CompletionException && t.getCause() != null)
299         return t.getCause();
300      return t;
301   }
302
303   private static int deriveStatus(Throwable err) {
304      if (err == null)
305         return 200;
306      if (err instanceof BasicHttpException err2)
307         return err2.getStatusCode();
308      return 500;
309   }
310
311   private static String resolveUriTemplate(RestOpSession opSession) {
312      try {
313         var pp = opSession.getContext().getPathPattern();
314         return pp == null ? "" : pp;
315      } catch (RuntimeException e) {
316         // Defensive: getPathPattern() dereferences pathMatchers[0]; protect against any unusual routing setup.
317         return "";
318      }
319   }
320}
